issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Dograh
products.tagline: The open source VAPI alternative
products.summaryZh: 开源的VAPI替代方案
products.descriptionZh: 封闭式语音平台迫使你租用自有的智能体。Dograh完全开源，没有任何功能被锁定。可视化流程构建器，支持在30多种集成中添加你的模型密钥，或使用本地模型，电话功能、人工转接以及高级质量保证与监控——全部免费，一条命令即可自托管。此外，还可通过MCP连接你的Claude Code，为特定用例或通话录音构建语音智能体。
products.description: Closed voice platforms make you rent your own agents. Dograh is completely open source- nothing is gated. Visual flow builder, add your model key across 30+ integrations or use local models, telephony, human transfer, and advanced QA & monitoring - all free to self-host in one command. Also connect your claude code with MCP to build voice agents for a use case or call recordings.

products.name: Grok Bot
products.tagline: AI teammates that you can give real work to
products.summaryZh: 你可以交付实际工作的AI队友。
products.descriptionZh: 推出Grok Bot：能交付实际工作的AI队友。Bots登录你的工具，像你一样使用它们，并带回完成的工作。像对待队友一样给它们发消息。它们保持上下文，多任务处理，并在自己的云端电脑上学习你的工作风格。让Bots夜间执行外呼任务，从Gmail整理费用，安排招聘现场，调整付费广告，或发布修复包。只有在需要你批准时，它们才会回来。
products.description: Introducing Grok Bot: AI teammates you can give real work to. Bots sign into your tools, use them like you do, and come back with finished work. Message them like a teammate. They keep context, multitask, and learn your working style on their own cloud computer. Ask Bots to run outbound overnight, code expenses from Gmail, schedule a recruiting onsite, rebalance paid ads, or ship a bug pack. They only come back when something needs your approval.

products.name: Lettertrace
products.tagline: Track your AI visibility for free (using your own API keys!)
products.summaryZh: 免费追踪你的AI可见度（使用你自己的API密钥！）
products.descriptionZh: Lettertrace 衡量 Claude、ChatGPT 和 Gemini 提及你公司的频率。但有个前提：它免费、面向开发者优先、自带密钥，且开源。
products.description: Lettertrace measures how often Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini mention your company. But there's a catch: it's free, developer-first, bring-your-own-key, and open source.

products.name: Assembly Studio
products.tagline: AI app builder that grows your revenue
products.summaryZh: AI应用构建器，助力营收增长
products.descriptionZh: Assembly Studio 是专为专业服务公司打造的AI应用构建工具。描述你的需求：入职代理、分析仪表板、社区中心，几分钟内即可获得生产级应用。提供20多个可混搭模板。可连接任何第三方工具。克隆任何按席位收费的昂贵应用。永久免费计划。停止为别人的软件付费。构建只有你能构建的公司。
products.description: Assembly Studio is the AI app builder made for professional service firms. Describe what you want: onboarding agents, analytics dashboards, community hubs, and get production-grade apps in minutes. 20+ templates to remix. Connects to any 3rd-party tool. Clone any overpriced app charging you per seat. Free forever plan. Stop paying for someone else's software. Build the firm only you can build.

products.name: Unsloth Desktop
products.tagline: Run and train AI models locally on your desktop
products.summaryZh: 在您的桌面上本地运行和训练AI模型
products.descriptionZh: Unsloth Desktop是一款开源应用，用于在本地运行和训练AI模型。支持运行大语言模型、图像/视频扩散模型及音频模型。通过一条命令即可将Claude Code或Codex等代理连接到本地GPU，并可通过无代码工作流对模型进行微调。
products.description: Unsloth Desktop is an open-source app to run and train AI models locally. Run LLMs, image/video diffusion, and audio. Connect agents like Claude Code or Codex to your local GPU with one command, and fine-tune models with no-code workflows.

products.name: BearDrive
products.tagline: The open-source shared folder for your team's AI agents
products.summaryZh: 面向团队AI代理的开源共享文件夹
products.descriptionZh: 你的AI代理会在本地生成真实文件：报告、演示文稿、CSV、研究资料。BearDrive同步它们已工作的文件夹，因此每个文件从诞生起即共享：带版本记录，精确到代理会话归属，且仅你的团队可打开链接。与Notion或Drive不同，无需任何人移动文件；队友的代理能在几秒内通过真实本地路径读取你代理的工作成果。兼容Claude Code、Cowork、Codex、Gemini CLI及任何本地工具。开源且可自托管。测试期间托管服务免费。
products.description: Your AI agents create real files locally: reports, decks, CSVs, research. BearDrive syncs the folder they already work in, so every file is born shared: versioned, attributed down to the agent session, with links only your team can open. Unlike Notion or Drive, nobody moves anything; a teammate's agent reads your agent's work at a real local path seconds later. Works with Claude Code, Cowork, Codex, Gemini CLI, any local tool. Open source and self-hostable. Managed service free during beta.

products.name: Swipe
products.tagline: Swipe right on your next customer
products.summaryZh: 向右滑动，遇见下一位客户
products.descriptionZh: 明确你的目标客户。Swipe为你呈现一组按优先级排序的真实公司卡片。保留值得发邮件的，跳过其余，导出为CSV。无需注册，无需积分，不抓取收件箱。
products.description: Type who you sell to. Swipe deals a ranked deck of real companies. Keep the ones worth an email, skip the rest, export to CSV. No signup, no credits, no scraped inboxes.

products.name: LaraCopilot
products.tagline: Agentic AI Engineer that builds real apps
products.summaryZh: Agentic AI工程师，构建真实应用
products.descriptionZh: LaraCopilot是一款智能AI工程师，能够构建真实、可投入生产的应用。用你自己的语言描述想法，它就能构建整个应用：界面、后端、数据库、认证和API，全部整合并准备部署。一键部署到云端或你自己的服务器，支持GitHub导出，即时回滚。无锁定，代码归你所有。
products.description: LaraCopilot is an agentic AI engineer that builds real, production-ready apps. Describe your idea in your own language and it builds the whole thing: UI, backend, database, auth, and APIs, wired together and ready to deploy. One-click deploy to the cloud or your own server, GitHub export, instant rollback. No lock-in. The code is yours.

products.name: Click
products.tagline: Live research context for ChatGPT and Claude
products.summaryZh: ChatGPT与Claude的实时研究背景
products.descriptionZh: Click是一个MCP，提供广泛的研究连接器，以补充内置网络搜索所遗漏的外部上下文。它从专业及社交平台、市场、金融等领域提供实时信息。在ChatGPT或Claude中简单安装该MCP，仅需一分钟，即可在聊天中实现更多功能。
products.description: Click is an MCP that provides extensive research connectors to give external context that the built-in web search misses. It provides live context from professional & social platforms, marketplaces, financials, and more. A simple 1-min installation of the MCP in ChatGPT or Claude enables you to do more inside chat.

products.name: CodeBurn
products.tagline: See where your AI coding spend actually goes
products.summaryZh: 看看你的AI编程支出究竟花在了哪里
products.descriptionZh: CodeBurn 是一款免费开源的 AI 编程成本追踪工具。它读取你的工具已生成的会话文件——涵盖 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Copilot 等共 40 种，并按任务、模型、项目和拉取请求展示每个 token 和美元花费。Optimize 标签页可发现缓存膨胀或重试成本等浪费，应用修复并追踪实际节省。所有操作都在本地运行：无需账户，不上传数据。采用 MIT 许可证，完全免费，全球超过 15 万开发者使用。
products.description: CodeBurn is a free, open-source tracker for AI coding costs. It reads the session files your tools already write - Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, 40 in all, and shows every token and dollar by the task, model, project, and pull request that used it. The Optimize tab finds waste like cache bloat or retry tax, applies the fix, and tracks what it actually saved. Everything runs on your machine: no account, no uploads. MIT-licensed and genuinely free, used by 150k+ developers across the world.

products.name: Chat Agent by Trigger.dev
products.tagline: AI chat that keeps running after you close the tab
products.summaryZh: 关闭标签页后仍持续运行的AI聊天。
products.descriptionZh: Chat agent是一种构建持久AI聊天体验的方式，它在无超时的机器上运行，并在刷新或崩溃时保持流式传输。当无人输入时，机器进入休眠状态，并在离开处唤醒，无需您管理任何状态。保留您已使用的AI SDK：服务器端使用streamText，客户端使用useChat。chat.agent作为底层传输层嵌入，两者之间的API路由随之消失。每一轮交互都被追踪：提示词、工具调用、延迟和成本。
products.description: Chat agent is a way to build durable AI chat experiences that run on a machine with no timeouts and keep streaming through refreshes and crashes. The machine sleeps when nobody's typing and wakes where it left off, without you managing any state. Keep the AI SDK you already use: streamText on the server, useChat on the client. chat.agent slots in underneath as a transport and the API route between them goes away. Every turn is traced: prompts, tool calls, latency and cost.

products.name: Media Sharing
products.tagline: Let AI agents put screenshots and videos on pull requests
products.summaryZh: 让AI代理在拉取请求中附上截图和视频。
products.descriptionZh: GitHub没有提供将图片附加到拉取请求的API，因此代理和CI在操作时如同盲飞。Argos媒体分享解决了这一问题：一条命令即可将截图或录制内容转换为稳定的分享链接，并附带可直接粘贴的Markdown格式，同时自动发布到PR上。
products.description: GitHub has no API for attaching images to pull requests, so agents and CI ship blind. Argos Media Sharing fixes it: one command turns a screenshot or recording into a stable share link with ready-to-paste Markdown, and posts it on the PR automatically.

products.name: Ballet
products.tagline: Agentic workflows that deliver the same outcome every time
products.summaryZh: 每次都能产生相同结果的代理式工作流
products.descriptionZh: Ballet让运维团队在几分钟内自动化处理最棘手的业务问题。用通俗英语描述工作流程。Ballet以代码形式编写并运行，附带完整审计日志、一键回滚、模拟模式，且由你决定其操作权限范围。
products.description: Ballet lets operations teams automate their hardest business problems in minutes. Describe a workflow in plain English. Ballet writes (in code) + runs it, with full audit log, one-click rollback, simulation mode, and you choose how much it can do.

products.name: Sidekick™
products.tagline: The agentic interface
products.summaryZh: 代理式界面
products.descriptionZh: Mac的下一个重大界面，也是您整个组织的智能代理层。
products.description: The next big interface for your Mac and the agentic layer for your entire organisation.

products.name: Linforge
products.tagline: Turn Anki flashcards into real English conversations
products.summaryZh: 将Anki卡片转化为真实的英语对话
products.descriptionZh: 像和真人聊天一样练习英语口语。Linforge 提供即时音素级发音和语法纠正，覆盖每个句子，同步你的 Anki 卡片组，并长期追踪你的学习进度。
products.description: Practice English speaking like you're chatting with a real person. Linforge gives instant phoneme-level pronunciation and grammar correction on every sentence, syncs with your Anki decks, and tracks your progress over time.

products.name: Cohesor
products.tagline: A neutral control plane for enterprise AI agents
products.summaryZh: 企业AI代理的中立控制平面
products.descriptionZh: Cohesor是AI代理的中立控制平面。它位于你的代理——Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、代理工作流及所有LLM模型之间：压缩约50%的token，将每个请求路由到合适规模的模型，并为团队按用户管理支出。一个端点，零代码改动，代理账单降低60–90%。代理支出激增，却几乎没有工具来理解或控制它。中立、成本优先的控制层是空白象限。Cohesor正是为此而生。
products.description: Cohesor is the neutral control plane for AI agents. It sits between your agents - Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, agentic workflow and every LLM model: compressing ~50% of tokens, routing each request to the right-sized model, and governing spend per user for your team. One endpoint, zero code changes, 60–90% lower agent bills. Agent spend is exploding with almost no tooling to understand or control it. The neutral, cost-first control layer is the empty quadrant. Cohesor is built for exactly that.

products.name: Nearfield
products.tagline: Turn two or more Studio Displays into stereo speakers
products.summaryZh: 将两台或多台Studio Display变成立体声扬声器
products.descriptionZh: Nearfield是一款原生开源Mac应用，可将两台Apple Studio Display的扬声器合并为一个可调节音量的立体声输出。支持左右声道互换、平衡调节，以及基于应用和窗口的音频路由。需要Apple silicon芯片、两台Studio Display以及macOS 14或更高版本。
products.description: Nearfield is a native, open-source Mac app that combines the speakers in two Apple Studio Displays into one volume-controllable stereo output. Swap left and right, adjust balance, and use app and window based audio routing. Requires Apple silicon, two Studio Displays, and macOS 14+.

products.name: Statewave
products.tagline: Open-source memory runtime for production AI agents.
products.summaryZh: 开源内存运行时，用于生产环境中的AI代理。
products.descriptionZh: 开源内存运行时，专为AI代理设计。持久化、结构化上下文，附带来源追踪，基于Postgres自托管。
products.description: Open-source memory runtime for AI agents. Durable, structured context with provenance, self-hosted on Postgres.

products.name: RightCard
products.tagline: The honest credit card picker — no bank login
products.summaryZh: 诚实的信用卡选择器——无需银行登录
products.descriptionZh: RightCard 会告诉你在任何商店该用哪张卡，并自动添加你可能会忘记激活的银行优惠（Amex、Chase、Citi、Wells Fargo）。它能理清轮换的5%返现类别，让你无需记忆，并在卡积分和年费续期前提醒你。无需银行登录、无需账户、无追踪——Safari 扩展程序读取你已登录的优惠页面，推荐在手机上计算，甚至离线也可用。只提供真实数据。免费，无广告。
products.description: RightCard tells you which of your cards to use at any store and auto-adds the bank offers you'd forget to activate (Amex, Chase, Citi, Wells Fargo). It keeps rotating 5% categories straight so you don't have to remember them, and warns you before card credits and annual fees renew. No bank login, no account, no tracking — the Safari extension reads the offers page you're already signed into, and recommendations are computed on your phone, even offline. Honest numbers only. Free, no ads.

products.name: tash
products.tagline: The investment platform for trading cards
products.summaryZh: 交易卡投资平台
products.descriptionZh: tash为投资者提供专业策划的高端评级交易卡组合。tash负责管理资产采购、验证、保管、报告以及最终出售相关资产。
products.description: tash gives investors access to professionally curated portfolios of high-end graded trading cards. tash manages sourcing, verification, vaulting, reporting, and the eventual sale of the underlying assets.
